Card Q&A.a: Digimon that aren't affected by effects aren't affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. Because this effect didn't delete, you can process the part of the effect after "if this effect didn't delete."
Card Q&A.q: What happens if an opponent's Digimon that isn't affected by effects is chosen for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent may delete 1 of their Digimon or Tamers. If this effect didn't delete, ＜Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫＞ and trash your opponent's top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing your bottom security card, it doesn't leave.
